findings.title: Compaction WIP scan reads linked design content

original_sources.exact_excerpt:
WIP_FOUND=false
for f in design/gdd/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    INCOMPLETE=$(grep -n -E "TODO|WIP|PLACEHOLDER|\[TO BE|\[TBD\]" "$f" 2>/dev/null)

findings.evidence_and_impact: The compaction helper validates its checkpoint but reads design/gdd Markdown using -f and grep, which follow symlinks. Safe canary fixtures demonstrate a linked file or linked gdd directory reaching output; this is local content exposure, not proven remote exfiltration.
findings.smallest_correction: Reject symlink design namespace components and matched Markdown documents before linked content is read; exit 2 with a non-content diagnostic.
findings.preserved_behavior: Ordinary WIP detection, existing checkpoint protections and state-retention behavior remain. No claim of a race-resistant filesystem sandbox.
